docs.title: Documentation
docs.description: Agent Studio puts planning, execution, handoffs, evidence and delivery into one traceable chain.
docs.guide.plan.title: From goal to plan
docs.guide.plan.point1: Describe the goal, constraints and acceptance criteria in the Workbench and choose the entry type.
docs.guide.plan.point2: Budgets, workflow, authorized files and model parameters live in Advanced run configuration, collapsed by default.
docs.guide.plan.point3: Review the plan before running is the default; execution starts only after confirmation.
docs.guide.runs.title: Observe execution
docs.guide.runs.point1: Flow view shows server-side plan nodes, dependencies, status and duration.
docs.guide.runs.point2: Click a node to inspect tool receipts, upstream handoffs, check evidence and the timeline on the right.
docs.guide.runs.point3: Step replay walks decisions, model calls and tool records in event order.
docs.guide.delivery.title: Accept delivery
docs.guide.delivery.point1: Delivery notes summarize the run conclusion, produced files, verification status and unverified items.
docs.guide.delivery.point2: File preview verifies the current SHA-256 and refuses to return stale content when the version changed.
docs.guide.delivery.point3: Git diffs, human review, local commits and push/merge each require explicit approval.
docs.guide.agents.title: Private Agents
docs.guide.agents.point1: Skills, read-only tools and Agents are visible only to the current account.
docs.guide.agents.point2: Versions are pinned after publishing; historical runs keep using the components from their publish time.
docs.guide.agents.point3: Private Agents can only join analysis or review nodes and cannot expand their own authorization.
docs.guide.evaluation.title: Evaluation and monitoring
docs.guide.evaluation.point1: Seed evaluations use simulated models and tools without touching real external services.
docs.guide.evaluation.point2: Dataset drafts are editable; published versions are immutable.
docs.guide.evaluation.point3: Monitoring counts only records retained in the local database; known usage is not a complete total.
docs.boundariesDescription: The page is only a projection of server state; every button action goes through controlled APIs that re-verify version, ownership and permissions. Model output is never acceptance evidence.
git.boundary: A workspace is not a sandbox. Commits include only approved tracked diffs; push and merge bind to the current HEAD and target branch, and conflicts or unknown results are never retried automatically.
git.reviewHint: Start a human review for the current uncommitted workspace diff
git.noReviewHint: No diff awaiting review; no review is needed
git.reviewNote: Only records a review of the current diff; it never commits, pushes or merges. Untracked files cannot be approved yet.
git.commitNote: Commits only approved tracked diffs; never pushes or merges. State changes reject the commit.
git.untrackedNote: Create a text file or review existing untracked files; review results bind to the content digest.
git.deliveryNote: Prepare a request, then approve and execute; conflict or unknown results are retained for manual verification.
git.copyUnsupported: Automatic copy is not supported in this browser; copy the commit information manually
git.deliveryUnknown: Unknown result; verify the remote or workspace
git.noDeliveries: No push or merge records yet.
